meta.name: Big 12 Studios
meta.description:
Big 12 Studios delivers the only dedicated channel for the excitement, passion, and culture of one of America's premier collegiate conferences. Big 12 Studios, your 24/7 home for highlights, replays, classic games, and original programming.

Shows: Baylor vs. TCU (10.18.25) Football Full Game Replay, Western Carolina vs. Cincinnati Football Full Game Replay (9.12.26), Big 12 Today (Oct. 16, 2026), TCU vs. Baylor Football 10.13.12, Inside the 12 presented by Old Trapper
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Tubi
